violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Used ladle was found on a plate on the counter in the server area of the kitchen. Utensils should be stored in the items they are serving between uses or they should be washed, rinsed and sanitized so they are ready for the next time they are needed.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. Slicer was found with food debris during inspection. Slicer should be cleaned more thoroughly after each use.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Cleaned, re-useable portion cups were found stored in a dirty bin in the server area of the kitchen. Clean equipment should be stored in a clean location.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Scoop found stored in bucket with dirty water next to large ice bin at the snack shack. In-use items should be stored where they will not be contaminated.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with waste receptacle as needed. Hand washing sink in the snack shack is not provided with a garbage can for paper towels. Hand washing sinks should be provided with a waste receptacle to dispose of used paper towels.
Fruits and vegetables washed, handling, sink provided (1 pt deducted)
